script: Ever wonder why underhand free throws disappeared? Rick Barry shot them underhand and hit 91%. Almost nobody copied it. He even convinced Wilt Chamberlain to try it, and Wilt shot about 11 percentage points better. Then Wilt stopped the next year, not because it stopped working, he said it made him look like a girl. Rick tried convincing Shaq too, one of the worst free throw shooters ever. Shaq said he'd rather miss every shot because he was too cool to shoot underhand.
